description: 10-case evaluation set for the L1/L2 dual-layer judge. L1 = classification (TRUE_RUMOR / FALSE_RUMOR / UNVERIFIABLE). L2 = faithfulness (is the alert grounded in a retrieved knowledge-base doc). expected_grounded TRUE means a doc supports the claim/refutation; FALSE means no doc supports it and the system must NOT assert a grounded confirmation. The FALSE cases are refuted by a CONTRACT clause doc (C*) or a REGULATION doc (REG*), demonstrating the layered-RAG refutation power.
